name: Chef Breanna
summary: In Lakeshire, Chef Breanna keeps the Stormwind soldiers fed as they guard the Redridge Mountains. She leads the town's kitchen, using hearty local ingredients to help the defenders hold on.

sections.title: Feeding Lakeshire's Defenders
sections.body: Chef Breanna runs a restaurant house in northwestern Lakeshire with her assistants, Crystal Boughman and Gretchen Vogel. She feeds the entire local battalion, whose strength matters as Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and murlocs besiege the town. Stormwind's garrison is understaffed, so every meal counts. Her signature Redridge Goulash draws on wild game and beasts from the surrounding ridges to feed the weary guards.

faq.answer: Chef Breanna runs the kitchen house in northwestern Lakeshire. She feeds the Stormwind soldiers defending the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: What does Chef Breanna need help with?
faq.answer: Chef Breanna needs local game meat for Redridge Goulash, made for the garrison. Around Lakeshire, you can gather tough condor meat, goretusk snouts, and crisp spider meat.
Crystal Boughman and Gretchen Vogel work with Chef Breanna at her restaurant house. They help manage it and tend to hungry townsfolk and soldiers.

angles.text: Breanna's Redridge Goulash turns spiders, condors, and goretusks from the surrounding wilds into a hearty meal for a military outpost.
Chef Breanna feeds the soldiers holding Lakeshire's bridge and town perimeter. Without her cooking, the strained garrison could quickly tire as orcs and gnolls press their relentless incursions.
